Hi Priyom,

Quick note on invoice INV-2026-998 (PO 8899). Our card attempt failed during authorization this morning and AP has put the item on hold pending a VAT certificate and remittance instructions. We need the following to move forward: 1) a copy of Redwood's EU VAT registration or certificate we can attach to our payment record, and 2) explicit remittance details (bank beneficiary, swift/IBAN, reference to include).

Can you confirm whether you can accept a partial wire now and the remainder via card retry? If so, AP is willing to push a 60% wire to clear the oldest exposure and finish the balance on the next card cycle.

We need confirmation by EOD Wednesday (Oct 7) to meet our internal cutoff for next week. Attaching our PO for reference.

Thanks,

- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Bank: First West Bank
- IBAN: GB29FIRW00000000000000 (use as remittance reference)
- Cutoff for same-day credit to our account: 15:00 BST (we are in EU time for settlement)

I have attached our EU VAT certificate for your records as well (VAT-certificate-redwood-eu.pdf). Marissa is cc'd to confirm when the wire posts and to provide a remittance receipt. Karthik is looped in for any tax-match questions.

If you can confirm the date the 60% wire will be initiated and the expected value date, we'll queue reconciliation on our side. Also confirm whether AP needs a billing contact for any bank queries (we can provide a payments specialist).

Best,
